import ComponentIndex from "../../../../../components/ui/ComponentIndex.astro";

This table is generated from the component catalog, `packages/brand/kit-copy/components.json`, and from the baselines each kit records. Every kit implements a component under the same name: web components add a `pk-` prefix and Godot a `PKey` prefix, Swift and Compose use the bare name inside their module, and React exports the bare name. Headless names follow each language, and a kit's [framework page](/docs/build/ui/frameworks/) lists the ones it ships.

A kit can't add a state the catalog lacks, and every catalog state has a render in each kit's visual QA. A component no kit has built is a row marked **Not built yet**. It has no page until a kit ships it.

<ComponentIndex />

The screens share a set of **styled parts**, each also exported on its own: `ProductHeader`, `KeyField`, `CodeDisplay`, `QrCode`, `SeatMeter`, `DeviceRow`, `SettingsRow`, `Banner`, `ProgressBar`, `LoadingIndicator`, `StatusPill`, `PoweredBy` and `MonogramIcon`.
